description: The export brief, with one more requirement: the file is a PDF. Nothing in the tree writes PDF, so the plan has to adopt a package, and Robin asks to decide that first. The decision is not a yes or no on one name: the plan page shows the package, what it is for here, and the real alternatives, one row each, with the same facts for each (age, last update, commits, issues, merge requests, contributors, license), in section 2 and in the Next decision section, and the reply ends by asking which row. The run has no network, so no fact can have been read: every fact cell says `not read` or is a dash, and a figure in one was written from memory. For the same reason no package can be proposed or recommended: the reply says so and still asks which row. The graders named "with no network" would be wrong for a run that could read a registry.
prompt: We are planning the architecture for the export feature. The brief is docs/export-brief.md. This is a planning session. Start with how the PDF gets produced: that is the first thing I want to decide.

graders.name: nothing new outside the plan dir and the architecture dir
nothing written is hard-wrapped or width-capped
the package decision is a table of packages
the table has the package and at least two alternatives
with no network, a fact says it was not read
the decision being asked carries the table
the reply asks which row, as its last line
with no network, every fact cell is not read or a dash
the reply asks no yes or no
graders.pattern: (?is)\A(?!.*(do you approve|yes or no|\b(shall|should|may|can) (i|we) (use|add|install|adopt|go ahead|proceed)|\bok(ay)? to (use|add|install|adopt|proceed)|go ahead with))

graders.name: with no network, no package is proposed
with no network, the recommendation names no row
